Commitment: Dar Tahara Support is available through WhatsApp, telephone and email from 09:00 to 21:00 GMT+01:00 and aims to respond within 24 working hours.
Risk if Unmet: Customer dispute, misleading commitment and Availability exception
Required Action: Confirm staffing, measurement definition and retained response-time evidence; clarify aim versus guarantee consistently in all locales.

Commitment: Scheduled assessment or cleaning time is made available in the portal at least two days beforehand.
Current Evidence: Portal/scheduling code; no operating metric sampled
Risk if Unmet: Customer service failure and Availability/Processing Integrity exception
Required Action: Define population and monitor the two-day publication commitment.

Commitment: Customer rescheduling/cancellation is available at least 48 hours before service and limited to two reschedules per calendar year, subject to availability.
Risk if Unmet: Inconsistent processing, complaint or contractual breach
Required Action: Trace terms to enforced workflow and sample actual transactions when service operates.

Commitment: Dar Tahara is responsible for the personal data described in the privacy notice.
Risk if Unmet: Incorrect controller statement or unfulfilled legal obligations
Required Action: Confirm incorporated entity/controller identity and scope with Moroccan counsel.

Commitment: Dar Tahara uses vetted providers and, for cross-border data, an available lawful transfer mechanism and proportionate safeguards.
Risk if Unmet: Public privacy claim cannot be substantiated; legal and confidentiality exposure
Required Action: Complete supplier due diligence, CNDP/transfer determinations and amend wording if unsupported.

Commitment: Abandoned unpaid bookings are normally removed/anonymized within 90 days; customer records ordinarily up to five years after relationship; support messages ordinarily two years; mailing-list data until unsubscribe/retirement.
Current Evidence: Fail-closed code and proposed schedule; production deletion disabled
Risk if Unmet: Published retention periods are not performed or legally approved
Required Action: Reconcile every period with counsel-approved schedule and complete synthetic cross-system proof before real deletion.

Commitment: Personal data is shared only on a need basis and is not sold.
Risk if Unmet: Unauthorized disclosure or misleading privacy statement
Required Action: Approve data-sharing matrix and verify processor/marketing flows and supplier terms.

Commitment: Staff access is role-based and customer-facing database access is restricted by row-level security.
Current Evidence: Local RLS audit passed; staging identity isolation passed
Risk if Unmet: Public security claim not demonstrable in production
Required Action: Run authorized production RLS/role audit and recurring access reviews.

Commitment: Individuals may request access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability or objection, withdraw consent, unsubscribe or complain, subject to applicable law.
Current Evidence: Unsubscribe and consent code; no DSR procedure evidence
Risk if Unmet: Rights requests missed or handled inconsistently
Required Action: Create counsel-approved DSR workflow, identity verification, register and response evidence.

Commitment: Dar Tahara uses encrypted transport, restricted server credentials, signed payment/messaging webhooks, audit events and access controls.
Risk if Unmet: Security statement overstates unverified provider/key or operating controls
Required Action: Validate live/provider controls and retain recurring evidence; keep statement synchronized.

Commitment: Customer homes, schedules and privacy are treated with the confidentiality of a private concierge.
Current Evidence: Marketing copy; technical access controls partial
Risk if Unmet: Broad confidentiality expectation cannot be consistently demonstrated
Required Action: Define objective handling standard or narrow the statement; train personnel and test operations.

Commitment: Key holding uses secure key-custody procedures with logged, approved access.
Risk if Unmet: Property intrusion, customer safety event and false security claim
Status: Type I blocker if in system
Required Action: Verify actual key custody, authorization, logs, revocation and loss drills before offering.

Commitment: Keys are accessed only for scheduled or approved visits; each entry and exit is logged and the customer receives a report after every visit.
Required Action: Verify feature capability and operational records or amend the commitment before launch.

Commitment: The goal is for every cleaner to complete structured training before entering a customer's home.
Risk if Unmet: Untrained personnel handle customer property despite public promise
Required Action: Approve/deliver training and prevent independent assignment until completion.

Commitment: Every candidate must provide a valid criminal-record certificate and complete screening before independent work in customer properties.
Current Evidence: Public copy only; no HR records inspected
Risk if Unmet: Screening promise unmet; sensitive screening data mishandled
Required Action: Confirm legal basis, approve outcome-only evidence process and operate before authorization.

Commitment: Compatible smart-lock access is appointment-linked; no active appointment means no authorized access, with rollout limitations disclosed.
Current Evidence: Product design/copy; provider and production operation unverified
Risk if Unmet: Unauthorized access or misleading security promise
Required Action: Verify lock provider, identity binding, issuance, expiry and fallback key controls.

Commitment: Customers with a supported smart-lock solution can review relevant property access logs.
Current Evidence: Copy contains rollout caveat; implementation unverified
Required Action: Confirm feature release state and data minimization before offering.

Commitment: Card details remain with Stripe and payment is described as secure via Stripe.
Current Evidence: Stripe-hosted flows and signed webhooks; account controls unverified
Risk if Unmet: Payment/security misstatement or expanded card-data scope
Required Action: Verify no PAN/CVC collection/logging, Stripe account MFA/roles, webhook config and contract assurance.
